Basically this is my mini-review the novel. I'll avoid major spoilers but there will be minor spoilers and I'll try to took about the themes broadly.

The novel is really ahead of its time and it still holds up really well. So it doesn't feel dated. Its also not as dumbed-down as other dystopian novels, so it is a bit difficult to read, but the challenge is rewarding.

The novel is set in 2025 after a Third World War in about 2011. The Third World War people stated on Mars, so people had time to flee underground. Killer robot armies (leadies) did most of the fighting, and most cities were decimated with nuclear and chemical weapons.

Since then, a techno-feudalistic elite has emerged, the Yance-men, who lord over large estates with their killer robot armies. The Yance-men lordships stretch across the Western world (Wes-Dem). The killer robots are maintained and built by people living underground (in 'tanks') who don't know the war is over, and are forced to slave away, driven by jingoist propaganda. This propaganda is produced by the Agency, in New York, and all Yance-men work for the Agency.

World War III only lasted a couple years, until the commanders of Wes-Dem, General Holt, and Pac-Peop, General Harenzany, reached a truce. The propaganda is delivered by Talbot Yancy, the "Protector", and political commissars in the ant-tanks force everyone to watch the speeches detailing the horrors of the "ongoing" war and extolling them ramp up production.

The second chapter introduces Nicolas St. James, who is President of one of the underground ant-tanks. However the lead mechanic of the bunker is dies of pancreatic failure, and is put on ice. So St. James is going to have to leave to find an artificial organ. It had a kind of Fallout feel that I enjoyed.

Enough beating around the bush. I want to detail the themes of the book and how prescient they are.

-The supreme legal arbitrators to earth are robots (leadies) on the Recon Dis-In Council. This really touches on themes like transhumanism and globalism.

-The history of World War II had been rewritten for the Cold War and World War III. In The Penultimate Truth, Hitler was just trying to warn the West about Bolshevism and the British committed most the atrocities and the blamed the Nazis. What we are seeing in our own reality is that the Soviets were actually allies of the Nazis, and the Western allies did the lion's share of defeating. In any case rewriting World War II is the foundational myth of the modern world.

-Those who emerge from the ant-tanks are herded into confabs. The Confabs are made by global real estate developer Louis Runcible. Confabs have higher accommodations and lighter workloads, but are still prisons. I really couldn't help but see the ant-tanks are police state wage-slavers in soypods, while Confabs are like a UBI consumerist nanny state.

-The people in ant-tanks are kept underground in fear of made up diseases like the Bag Plague and Stinking Shrink which are said to wipe out everyone on the surface. This is like the COVID hoax keeping everyone indoors while the billionaires gut the economy and consolidate their wealth, like the Yance-men.

PKD had an uncanny sense of foresight.
